title: Content Creator
company: Greenfield I T Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Content Creator - Social & Video
York
Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)
£30,000 - £35,000 per annum plus company benefits

Are you passionate about social media, video production and digital storytelling? We're recruiting on behalf of our client for a creative Content Creator to join their marketing team and help produce engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and other digital channels.

The Role:
- Create engaging short-form video content for social media.
- Take content from concept to filming, editing and final delivery.
- Produce social graphics, digital assets and campaign content.
- Film, edit and repurpose video content across multiple platforms.
- Support wider marketing campaigns with creative content.
- Monitor trends and develop fresh content ideas that drive engagement.
- Assist with longer-form video projects, interviews and promotional content.

The Candidate:
- 1-3 years' experience in content creation, social media, video production or a similar role.
- Strong portfolio showcasing video and social content.
- Skilled in Canva, CapCut and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, Photoshop and Illustrator.
- Strong filming, editing and storytelling abilities.
- Good understanding of social media trends and platform-specific content.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects.
- Creative, proactive and confident working independently or as part of a team.
- Comfortable appearing on camera when required.

For further information please contact Paige Bevan on or email
